instruction: Design a system that combines a half adder and a 6-to-1 multiplexer. The half adder should add two bits without carry-in, using a combination of XOR and AND gates, and generate a sum and carry-out as outputs. The 6-to-1 multiplexer should select one of the six 4-bit inputs based on the value of sel. If sel is an even number, the output should be the bitwise AND of the selected input and 0x0F. If sel is an odd number, the output should be the bitwise OR of the selected input and 0xF0. If sel is greater than 5, the output should be 0. The system should include an additional functional module that takes in both the sum and selected output and generates a final output by performing a bitwise XOR operation.
label: trojan
